name: amazon-eu-price-compare
description: This extension compares prices across the ten European Amazon marketplaces (de, fr, it, es, nl, pl, se, be, ie, uk)

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.release: npm test && npm run build && npm run lint:bundle && npm run zip && npm run lint:firefox
scripts.start:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start:chrome: npm run build:chrome && npx --yes web-ext run --target chromium --source-dir dist/chrome
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox --channel unlisted --artifacts-dir dist/signed
scripts.zip: npm run zip:chrome && npm run zip:firefox

author: Tiexin Guo
